  "situation": "The FISC is reviewing proposed Section 702 targeting, minimization, and querying procedures under the Fourth Amendment. The government’s interest in obtaining foreign intelligence to protect national security is substantial, while the procedures may affect U.S.-person privacy interests in the aggregate. U.S.-person queries can retrieve information about people who were not Section 702 targets, and can expose private information or be used in investigations unrelated to national security. The procedures include protections for minimizing, retaining, using, and disclosing U.S.-person information. The FBI had a record of misunderstandings and persistent querying problems, and the assessment of its likely implementation depended on the anticipated efficacy of improvement measures. The FISC is considering the procedures together, while a Second Circuit decision has treated certain U.S.-person queries as separate Fourth Amendment events.",
